compute_single_participation_sensitivity: compute the sensitivity of a matrix with a single participation using single_participation_sensitivity
compute_min_sep_sensitivity_upper_bound: compute the min_sep sensitivity upper bound for a Gram matrix X using get_min_sep_sensitivity_upper_bound_for_X
compute_banded_sensitivity: compute the sensitivity of a banded Gram matrix X using get_sensitivity_banded_for_X
compute_fixed_epoch_sensitivity: compute the sensitivity of a Gram matrix under fixed-epoch participation using fixed_epoch_sensitivity_for_X
create_banded_symmetric_mask: create an n x n symmetric banded mask matrix with a given number of bands using banded_symmetric_mask
